resources.string: Audio workspace
Create audio
Audio gathers local speech, music, sound effects, and voices in one workspace. Choose the kind of audio you want to make.
Write your prompt or text, run it, and play the result in the workspace. Finished clips are saved to the audio gallery.
If nothing runs, open Audio models from this screen and install the model the task needs.
Queue longer audio jobs
Long audio generations can be added to the generation queue so you can keep using the app.
Open the generation queue to follow progress. A finished job keeps its audio file and history entry.
If a job fails, read the error in the queue, fix the model or settings, and add it again.
Audio models
Install speech models
Audio models lists curated speech model bundles and lets you add a custom one. Pick the bundle for the voice or recognition task you need.
Start the download and wait for the bundle to show as installed. It then appears in the matching Audio tool.
If a download fails, check storage and connection, retry, or use a custom bundle with a valid prefix.
Generation queue
Follow queued generations
The generation queue lists image, video, and audio jobs waiting to run or already running, one at a time.
Each row shows its state and progress. Finished jobs move to the history, where you can open the result.
Cancel a stuck job from its row, or open the history to see why a failed job stopped before re-adding it.
DeepSeek task viewer
Watch a DeepSeek task
This viewer shows a project the main model handed to the DeepSeek subagent: its state, current phase, and elapsed time.
Scroll the subagent conversation and Harness activity. Context usage and disk cache size show how much the subagent has used.
If it shows Needs direction or Failed, read the model error, copy the diagnostics, and reply in the main chat to continue.
Server editor
Edit a local model server
The server editor sets how a local llama.cpp server launches the chosen model, including context size and every launch option.
Save to keep the profile. You return to Chats, where the server is ready to start and chat with.
If the server crashes or runs out of memory, reopen the editor, lower the context or offload, and save again.
Servers
Manage servers and sharing
Servers collects model servers, sharing, distributed inference, Ollama, and Termux in one place. Each card has an Open or Manage button.
Cards show live status such as saved servers or the Termux connection, so you can see what is running before opening it.
If a card shows disconnected or nothing saved, open it and finish its setup, then come back to check the status.
Search
Search the whole app
Global search looks across tools, chats, Agent projects, installed models, and notes. Type in the search box.
Results are grouped by kind. Use Show all to expand a group, then tap a result to open it. Recent searches are kept for quick reuse.
If nothing is found, try another word; English and Spanish names both work. Clear recent searches to start fresh.
